propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 share identical 1,000,000 token windows, making escalation from sonnet to opus a guaranteed no-op retry at higher cost.
Context-limit retry loops consume models_at_or_above without filtering equal-window rungs, causing wasted paid calls and misleading operator diagnosis.
New function escalation_rungs filters out rungs that do not represent a strict capacity increase over the current rung.
Both escalation loops (pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder) must switch to escalation_rungs to avoid no-op paid retries.
Declared window figures are verified correct against provider live API; the defect is in ladder consumption, not the data.
models_at_or_above and MODEL_LADDER remain unchanged to preserve provider stickiness observables and size budgets.
